svg.aria-label: A transaction travels from the client app through the gateway, validation, plugins, and signing, before Kora either returns it or broadcasts it. Each stage is governed by a matching section of kora.toml or signers.toml.
svg.text: The liveness route bypasses all of these
kora.toml does not permit is rejected
Optional extra checks you opt into
Your signer signs and pays the SOL
